source: 228 standing proposals, read by Claude against src/features/clubs/knowledge/profiles.json and each team's events
rules: EA: a bare name whose only event is the Elite Academy league is the club's EA team; the league fields one side per club per age.
coach: a surname on a tournament entry resolves to a tier through the club's coaching roster in the knowledge base.
spelling: two entries that differ only in how one league or coach is written.

suggestions.why: EA rule: the bare row's only event is the EA league, so it is the EA team.
